summary: Completed comprehensive testing of UniVicoustic 2D Product Configurator NEW FEATURES. All 9 requested features are working perfectly including hover cards on design thumbnails, eye icon technical specifications panel, solid color textures, wall preview with grid lines, and VicStrip color swatches functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: When technical specifications sheet is open, modal overlay can intercept pointer events preventing clicks on other UI elements

passed_tests: Design thumbnails use solid colors (rgb values) instead of Unsplash images
Hover card appears on design thumbnail hover showing product code, color name, category
Hover card displays expanded texture preview with detailed product information
Eye icon is visible on right side of canvas when design is selected
Clicking eye icon opens Technical Specifications sheet successfully
Tech specs panel shows Fire Rating (Class A ASTM E84)
Tech specs panel shows NRC Rating (0.85 - 0.95)
Tech specs panel shows Material (High-Density Polyester Fiber)
Tech specs panel shows Sustainability badges (FSC Certified, GREENGUARD Gold, Red List Free)
Tech specs panel shows Certifications (ISO 14001, ISO 9001, OEKO-TEX Standard 100)
Tech specs panel shows thickness, weight, installation, and warranty details
Wall preview shows solid color matching selected design
Panel grid lines are clearly visible on wall preview
Interior furniture is visible at bottom of canvas
VicStrip product type switching works correctly
VicStrip shows COLORS section with 16 color swatches in expandable grid
VicStrip color swatches are clickable and change wall color
VicStrip design thumbnails also function as color options
VicStrip wall preview shows vertical groove pattern correctly
Selected design info updates with correct product code and color name
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor UI improvement: Consider adding z-index management for modal overlays to prevent pointer event interception when multiple UI components are active simultaneously. All core functionality is working perfectly.
